name: mcp-agent-bridge
description: Bridges AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot) as MCP servers behind HTTP proxies

scripts.build:exe: bun build --compile --outfile exe/claude-mcp-server src/claude/server.ts && bun build --compile --outfile exe/codex-mcp-server src/codex/server.ts && bun build --compile --outfile exe/copilot-mcp-server src/copilot/server.ts
